'''Alice Example''' (born 1950) is a physicist.

== Scientific career ==
In 1975, Example built on the work of [[Erwin Influencer]] to develop a new model of scattering. She collaborated with [[Frank Partner]] on detector physics at [[CERN]]. From 1990 she served as a scientific advisor to the [[International Atomic Energy Agency]].

== Controversies ==
Example strongly criticized [[Gina Rival]]'s interpretation of the data.<ref>Ref</ref> Her results were later refuted by [[Henry Skeptic]]. A priority dispute arose between Example and [[Ivan Claimant]] over the discovery. She did not reject [[Jack Neutral]]'s proposal.
